podcast.title: Artwork Dispute with Friend
podcast.body: In 2007, a friend of Adam Jones named Cam De Leon, a well-known digital illustrator who worked on films like *Ghostbusters*, claimed credit for some artwork he had created for Tool. This dispute led to a complex, multi-level lawsuit involving the band and their insurance company, which lasted for eight years. "A friend of guitarist Adam Jones named Cam De Leon, claimed that he created some artwork for the band and wanted some credit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Special Effects Designer
podcast.body: Before and during his musical career, Adam Jones worked as a special effects designer in the movie business. "Guitarist Adam Jones was a special effects designer in the movie business."

podcast.title: Student of Tom Morello's Mother
podcast.body: Adam Jones, guitarist for Tool, had Tom Morello's mother as his home-room teacher. "The mother of Tom Morello... was the home-room teacher of Adam Jones, guitarist with tool."

xref.title: Early Band Efforts
xref.body: Formed when Tom Morello was approximately 16 or 17 years old, Electric Sheep included Adam Jones, who would later become the guitarist for Tool, playing bass. The band was noted for its enthusiastic approach and strong political convictions, despite many of its members lacking significant musical proficiency. "The bass player in the group was a guy named Adam Jones. And that's the same Adam Jones that now plays guitar in Toul."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Early Connection to Adam Jones
xref.body: While attending school in Illinois, Tom Morello was in the same class as Adam Jones, who would later become the guitarist for Tool. They also played together in early bands like Electric Sheep. "In the same class was this kid named Adam Jones. He would later grow up to be the guitarist and tool. After picking up the guitar at age 13, he played in a bunch of bands with names like Nebula and Electric Sheep, which, by the way, also featured Adam Jones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Family Connection to Adam Jones
xref.body: Tom Morello, guitarist for Rage Against the Machine, Audioslave, and Prophets of Rage, has a family connection to Adam Jones of Tool. Morello's mother was Adam Jones's home-room teacher. "The mother of Tom Morello, guitarist for rage against the machine, audio slave and profits of rage, was the home-room teacher of Adam Jones, guitarist with tool."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Instrumental in Forming Tool
xref.body: Tom Morello played a crucial role in the formation of the band Tool by introducing his former classmate Adam Jones and Jones's new friend, singer Maynard James Keenan, to drummer Danny Carey. "Meanwhile, Adam Jones, who had also moved west, was looking to form his own band. Tom introduced Adam and his new friend, singer, Maynard James Keenan, to a drummer named Daddy Kerry. So, yeah, Tom basically put two all together."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Support from Tool
xref.body: Rage Against The Machine gained significant early exposure by opening for Tool at some of their concerts. Adam Jones of Tool, a friend of Tom Morello, invited Rage to perform, which helped their demo tape attract the attention of talent scouts and led to a bidding war. "Adam invited Rage to open for some of their gigs."
